subtitle.zh: 读取并解析 JSON 配置，按配置处理记录并建立索引。
subtitle.en: Reads and parses a JSON config, then processes records and builds an index.

output.zh: 按 id 建立的索引

description.zh: 把配置文件读进来，并解析成内部使用的配置对象。
description.en: Reads the config file and parses it into the config object used internally.

modules.label: readConfig

description.zh: 读文件并把原文交给解析
description.en: Reads the file and hands the raw text to the parser

detail.zh: 读取指定路径的配置文件，用 fs.readFileSync 同步读取整个文件为 UTF-8 字符串，再原样交给 parseConfig 解析。此处不做任何校验或转换。
detail.en: Reads the config file at the given path with fs.readFileSync as a UTF-8 string and hands it to parseConfig unchanged. No validation or conversion happens here.

description.zh: 把原始文本解析成配置对象
description.en: Parses the raw text into a config object

detail.zh: 接收 readConfig 传来的原始文本，调用 JSON.parse 解析为配置对象。解析失败时异常会向上抛出，由调用方决定如何处理。
detail.en: Takes the raw text from readConfig and parses it with JSON.parse. A parse failure propagates up to the caller.

modules.label: processRecords

description.zh: 按配置为每条记录打上来源
description.en: Tags every record with its source from the config

detail.zh: 遍历 records 数组，为每条记录展开并附加 config.source 字段，生成带来源标记的新记录，供后续按来源追踪或过滤。
detail.en: Walks the records array, spreading each record and adding a config.source field, producing records that can later be traced or filtered by source.

description.zh: 按 id 建立记录索引
description.en: Builds an index of records keyed by id

detail.zh: 接收处理后的记录数组，以每条记录的 id 为键、记录本身为值，用 Object.fromEntries 构建查找索引，供按 id 快速取用。
detail.en: Takes the processed records and builds a lookup index with Object.fromEntries, keyed by each record's id, so a record can be fetched by id.
